game.name: Now Playing
game.desc: Show the current song, playback state, and jukebox volume.

game.name: Play / Pause
game.desc: Pause or resume the shuffled arcade soundtrack.

game.name: Next Random Song
game.desc: Skip immediately to another randomly selected track.

game.name: Music Louder
game.desc: Raise jukebox gain without changing game audio volume.

game.name: Music Softer
game.desc: Lower jukebox gain without changing game audio volume.

game.name: Stop Music
game.desc: Stop soundtrack playback until Play / Pause is selected.
